title: AtmoSync sensor reading
description: One environmental reading from a container transporting a perishable commodity. This contract validates the raw event shape only. It does not define spoilage thresholds.

container_id.description: Non-empty identifier of the monitored container.

commodity.description: Non-empty commodity name. Commodity-specific spoilage thresholds are outside this contract.

temperature.description: Numeric temperature. The physical unit is not fixed in this contract and must be agreed by the team before analytical use.

humidity.description: Humidity on a 0 to 100 scale, inclusive. Treat the value as a percentage unless a later contract revision defines a different scale.

vibration.description: Non-negative vibration magnitude. The unit of measure is not agreed yet and must be confirmed by the team before values are compared or used in risk models.

timestamp.description: Event time as an ISO 8601 date-time in the RFC 3339 profile used by JSON Schema, for example 2026-11-05T10:30:00Z.
